description: MLuBMS: An Ontology-Based Framework for Data-Adaptive and Multi-Level Building Material Stock Modeling is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Wanyu Pei, Shuyan Xiong (Department of Architecture, National University of Singapore). Ontology, reasoning/calculation code, validation scripts and an anonymized case-study database accompanying the paper 'An Ontology-Based Framework for Data-Adaptive and Multi-Level Building Material Stock Modeling' (Pei, Xiong, Cao, Habert, Stouffs; submitted to Environmental Science & Technology, 2026). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
